name: Text as a whole
title: REPORT on the proposal for a decision of the European Parliament and of the Council on the adoption by the Union of the Agreement on the interpretation and application of the Energy Charter Treaty between the European Union, the European Atomic Energy Community and their Member States
part_text:
The European Parliament approves the European Union joining an international agreement on how the Energy Charter Treaty is interpreted and applied. The Energy Charter Treaty is a deal that protects cross-border energy investments. The Parliament accepts the Commission's proposal without changes. This means the EU can formally sign up to this updated agreement alongside its member states. The Parliament also asks the Commission to come back to it if the proposal is later changed in a significant way.

- The EU moves closer to adopting the updated Energy Charter Treaty agreement, with no changes from Parliament.
- It affects EU member states, energy investors and countries that are part of the treaty.
- Next, the Council decides, and the EU can then formally adopt the agreement.
